scope: Local Linux source qualification. Relocated test engines and an ngspice temporary-file adapter; no packaged or consumer-machine acceptance.

wrappers.build/runtime/ngspice-run:
#!/bin/sh
runtime_dir="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)/ngspice"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$runtime_dir/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
export SPICE_SCRIPTS="$runtime_dir/usr/share/ngspice/scripts"
export ICSTUDIO_TEST_TMPDIR="$runtime_dir/../tmp"
export LD_PRELOAD="$runtime_dir/../tmpfile_adapter.so${LD_PRELOAD:+:$LD_PRELOAD}"
exec "$runtime_dir/usr/bin/ngspice" "$@"

adaptations: Magic and Netgen built from recorded source pins against locally extracted Tcl/Tk; headless engine invocation.
The ngspice42 binary is unmodified. LD_PRELOAD redirects temporary files into this workspace because system /tmp is not writable.
Actual engine outputs are retained by each qualifier; synthetic coupon tests are identified separately.
